text:
maya: FYI - we are seeing a spike of 503s from embed-service in eu-west1. Repro: KV cache null deref on warmup. I pushed a patch (2.3.2) that adds a guard and a short retry. Need an expedited deploy during the midday change window. @ops-oncall can you take ops signoff?

alex: saw the alerts, good catch. Can you paste the deploy command and rollback steps?

maya: Deploy command will be via deploybot: `deploy bot create --service embed-service --image gh/redwood/embed:2.3.2 --env=eu-west1 --canary=10%`
Rollback snippet if needed: ```kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/embed-service --to-revision=41```

sam: quick question - does 2.3.2 change any config or schemas?

maya: no schema changes, only defensive check and backoff. Short downtime risk only if canary fails.

ops-oncall: I need +1 from SRE and product for expedited. What's the customer impact?

maya: ~2% requests getting 503s for embeddings. Some downstream timeouts. Error budget for eu-west1 is close.

ryan: i can review logs and run canary smoke. I need a green e2e smoke before full roll.

DeployBot: New release requested: embed-service:2.3.2 by maya. Approvals required: alex, ryan, ops-oncall. To approve run `deploy bot approve 1711112222`

alex: +1 from me. Verified patch looks safe. :thumbsup:

sam: +1 from product, release notes updated: https://confluence/redwood/release-notes/embed/2.3.2

ops-oncall: heading in to validate infra. Holding until ryan confirms smoke.

ryan: ran smoke against canary (10%) - auth and embed flow ok, latencies normal, a couple of transient 500s in logs but didn't correlate with the NPE pattern. Marking smoke green.

ops-oncall: I see no infra anomalies. +1. Proceed when deploybot triggered.

maya: triggering deploy now. `deploy bot create --service embed-service --image gh/redwood/embed:2.3.2 --env=eu-west1 --canary=10% --auto-promote`

DeployBot: Deployment 1711112222 started: embed-service:2.3.2 -> eu-west1. Canary 10%.
text_continued:
DeployBot: Canary checks: readiness ok, latency within SLO, error-rate trending down. Promote to 50%.

ryan: watching metrics, KV cache related errors dropped to zero in canary. Looks good.

maya: promoting to 100% now.

DeployBot: Promotion to 100% in progress.

ops-oncall: quick note - if we see client-side timeouts spike, be ready to run `kubectl rollout undo` (I can run it).

sam: logging updated and release-note blurb posted to #customer-comms for heads up.

DeployBot: Deployment 1711112222 completed successfully: embed-service:2.3.2 is live in eu-west1. No rollback executed.

alex: thanks all. I'll add a short follow-up in the postmortem board with the root cause and why 2.3.2 is safe.

maya: huge thanks to the quick approvals and smoke run. :celebrate:

ops-oncall: closing the loop, switching monitoring back to normal alert thresholds.

ryan: leaving a note to track occurance window and link logs to the deploy: https://logs.redwood/embed/1711112222

sam: marking this hotfix as "expedited-approved" in the release tracker.

DeployBot: Release 1711112222 archived and tagged as hotfix/2.3.2. Audit: approvals alex, ryan, ops-oncall.
